record_scope_reconstruction: Renewed December11 blockade affects trucks entering Slovakia from Ukraine at VyšnéNemecké. Both first resumption and residual restriction phases share the road approach, with passenger and opposite-direction traffic outside scope.

source_checks.finding: STVR reports renewed protest after15:00 December11, Ukraine-to-Slovakia freight only, with tractors/cars on approach; passengers and outgoing Slovak trucks unaffected.
STVR reports final removal at21:00 December14; this does not collapse earlier partial-resumption interval.
Supplied Ukrinform partial-resumption URL returned404; that endpoint is not freshly verified.
